correctness.rationale: In H_n=K_n square K2, a missing vertex can be the internal vertex of a geodesic only if its matched column contains its other endpoint; therefore every column must be met. If one column is full, explicitly distinct selected cross-layer endpoint pairs cover every omitted vertex. If all columns are singly occupied, there are |P||Q| cross-layer endpoint pairs and n omitted vertices; cases |P|≤1 or |Q|≤1 are impossible, whereas |P|,|Q|≥2 admit an explicit injective allocation. This proves full iff classification and both displayed polynomials, including n=2,3 exceptional cases. Exactly-one-full-column deletion checks give upper strong geodetic number n+1. Minimum n≥4 transversals form rank layers 2..n−2 of n-cube; one token jump flips one bit. The rank interval is Hamming-isometric and connected n≥5; n=4 has six isolated vertices. Independent exhaustive geodesic-pair matching for all vertex subsets of n=2,3,4,5 matched iff criterion, counts, and inclusion-minimality. For n>=4 the exact all-set enumerator is z^n((2+z)^n−2n−2) and minimal-set enumerator (2^n−2n−2)z^n+2nz^(n+1). For n=2,3 they become z^n((2+z)^n−2^n) and n2^(n−1)z^(n+1), respectively.
residual_risks: Count is of labeled vertex subsets, not orbit types.
Geodesic paths cover vertices, NOT edges.
Large n proof is structural; small n enumeration alone is not an infinite proof.
